short_description: Validate customer orders, check stock/capacity, allocate to warehouse/route, verify packing, and dispatch.

questions.question: How do customer orders enter the operation and where are they recorded?
What checks are performed on order details, quantities, delivery address and payment/credit status?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Coordinator checks credit limit in accounting and verifies SKU codes manually...

questions.question: How is stock or capacity availability confirmed?
options: Warehouse supervisor physically checks racks or spreadsheet
Assumed available until picker cannot find it

questions.question: Who allocates the order to a warehouse, route or fulfilment team?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Operations planner assigns orders to regional depots each morning...

questions.question: How are picking, packing and loading verified against the order?
options: Paper pick list signed off by checker
Single picker packs and loads without independent check

questions.question: What documents and dispatch evidence are created?
What happens when stock, vehicle capacity, address or delivery slot is unavailable?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Order held on backorder sheet and customer service emailed to reschedule...

short_description: Consolidate shipment loads, assign drivers/vehicles, run pre-dispatch checks, and manage live route exceptions.

questions.question: What information is needed before a shipment can be planned?
options: Often incomplete until warehouse finishes packing

questions.question: How are loads consolidated and priorities determined?
options: Routing software groups stops by zone and SLA priority
Transport planner builds routes manually in spreadsheet / map
Handled ad hoc as orders finish

questions.question: Who selects the vehicle, driver, route and delivery sequence?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Transport coordinator assigns fleet drivers or third-party hauliers daily...

questions.question: What checks confirm vehicle, driver, documents and cargo are ready?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Driver pre-trip walkaround checklist + load manifest sign-off...

questions.question: How are dispatch instructions and handover details communicated?
options: Driver mobile app with stop details
Printed run sheet + WhatsApp / phone call

questions.question: How are delays, breakdowns, route changes or failed deliveries escalated?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Driver calls dispatcher who manually phones affected customers...

questions.question: Where is the live shipment status recorded and who updates customers?
options: Live TMS/GPS portal sends automatic ETA updates
Dispatcher tracks via driver calls and replies to customer emails
Customers only know if they call to ask

process_name: Proof of delivery and exception handling
short_description: Capture signed proof of delivery, resolve shortages or damage claims, and notify finance for billing.

questions.question: What counts as acceptable proof of delivery for your operation?
options: Geo-tagged photo of goods at site

questions.question: Who captures the proof and where is it stored?
options: Driver app syncs POD straight to central system
Driver takes WhatsApp photo or hands paper slip back at end of shift
Third-party carrier portal downloaded manually later

questions.question: How are quantity, condition and recipient details confirmed?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Receiver signs count on screen; shortages noted in remarks...

questions.question: What happens when delivery is refused, partial, late or unsuccessful?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Goods returned to depot and logged on exception sheet for rebooking...

questions.question: Who investigates damage, shortage or disputed delivery?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Operations supervisor checks warehouse load photos, driver notes, and customer claim...

questions.question: How are claims and customer updates tracked to resolution?
options: Central claims/exception log with owner and due date
Email chains between customer service, depot, and haulier

questions.question: How does finance or customer service know a delivery is complete and billable?
options: System automatically marks order billable once POD attaches
Admin compiles paper PODs at end of week and notifies finance
Finance invoices on dispatch and handles disputes later

short_description: Approve purchase orders, track supplier ETAs, inspect inbound deliveries against POs, and resolve shortages.

questions.question: How is the need for replenishment or purchasing identified?
options: System reorder trigger or MRP report
Warehouse/project lead emails or messages buyer
Manual stock check when running low

questions.question: What information and approvals are required before a purchase order is issued?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Quote, supplier terms, cost code; manager/finance sign-off over threshold...

questions.question: Who selects the supplier and confirms price, quantity and delivery terms?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Procurement officer checks approved supplier list and issues PO...

questions.question: How are supplier confirmations and expected delivery dates tracked?
options: PO tracker with confirmed ETA dates visible to warehouse
Buyer keeps confirmations in email inbox; warehouse doesn't always know when stock arrives

questions.question: Who checks received goods against the order and delivery documents?
options: Receiving team checks blind or against PO in WMS/ERP
Warehouse signs carrier note and hands paperwork to office later

questions.question: How are shortages, damage, substitutions or late deliveries recorded and escalated?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Quarantine note created, photos emailed to procurement to claim credit...

questions.question: When is the receipt accepted and the inventory or finance record updated?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Three-way match (PO + GRN + invoice) verified before payment and stock release...
